blocks.orig: As the sun sets over Mikumi National Park, the bush transforms into a different world entirely. Nocturnal creatures emerge from their hiding places – leopards begin to hunt, hyenas roam, and bush babies dart between the trees. Your guide will help you spot and understand the animals that only come alive after dark, from 7 PM to 11:30 PM. It is an experience that stays with you long after you leave.
blocks.html: Once the sun goes down over Mikumi National Park, the bush becomes a completely different world. Night-time animals come out of hiding – leopards start hunting, hyenas wander and bush babies flit through the trees. From 7 PM to 11:30 PM, your guide helps you find and understand the animals that only become active after dark. It’s an experience you’ll remember long after you’ve gone home.
